beats.say: This is Day 3 of AI agents that pay you back.

scene.sub: AI agents that pay you back

beats.say: Today it's the Raise Agent. It gets you ready to ask for more money, with real numbers.

scene.name: raise-agent
scene.desc: Logs your wins, reads real pay data for your job and city, and rehearses the talk with you.

beats.say: Every Friday you type win log, and paste what you did that week.

scene.text: win log: fixed the scheduling mess, closed 3 new clients

rows.t: Cut scheduling time 4 hrs a week

beats.say: Then it checks government pay data for your exact job and city, and shows you where you stand.

scene.title: Pay for your job, your city

beats.say: It plays your manager, and pushes back. No budget. Wait until review season. Then it coaches every answer.
You walk in with your number, your proof, and your answers ready.
One tip: if they say not now, get the goals and the date in writing.

scene.text: Not now? Ask exactly what you need to hit and by when. Send a follow up email the same day so it's in writing.

beats.say: Follow so you don't miss Day 4. And comment RAISE, and I'll send you the full setup straight to your DMs.
